source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of protecting personal information (PDF 189).

blocks.text: Zaati maloomat privacy settings istemal kar ke bachayein, maslan Facebook profile private kar ke ta ke sirf dost posts dekhein, aur awami maloomat mein ehtiyat se, apna ghar ka pata ya phone number kabhi awami taur par post na karein.

blocks.prompt: Class activity: maloom karein ke student NR3C-FIA ke saath Cyber Scout kaise ban sakta hai. Aisa programme kyun mufeed hoga?
blocks.explanation: Tarbiyat yafta students hum jamaaton aur khandan mein cyber hifazat ki aagahi phaila sakte aur online jurm ki shikayat ka tareeqa jaante hain; programme ki tafseel ke liye idare ki maujooda website dekhein.

items: Zaati maloomat bachayein: privacy settings aur pata ya phone number awami nahi.
